content_of_post_to_answer: How can someone keep improving themselves at home without getting overwhelmed by reels and social media distractions?
answer: The overlooked problem is that reels don't just consume time; they fragment attention, making even meaningful activities feel difficult afterward. Try separating improvement from entertainment physically: keep your phone away during one protected hour and choose a single skill to work on. Don't measure progress by how much you accomplish, but by how consistently you return to something worthwhile. I've explored this relationship between discipline and attention further on my Quora profile. A distracted mind doesn't necessarily need more motivation; it needs fewer interruptions.
